title: Smart warehousing

scenes.en: Monitor inclination at selected warehouse rack uprights and follow changes against the commissioning baseline. Link each reading to a rack location so warehouse teams can review persistent changes alongside loading patterns, handling activity and the scheduled rack inspection record.

scenes.briefen: Share the rack layout, upright dimensions, expected loading conditions and required inspection notifications.

scenes.title: Cantilever racking
scenes.en: Monitor inclination at selected upright columns in cantilever racks used for long or bulky goods. Identify each point by rack row and bay, then compare the angle history with recorded loading arrangements, handling activity and rack inspections. A consistent baseline helps the warehouse team review persistent changes after impact reports, support adjustments or changes in the lengths and weights stored on the arms.

scenes.briefen: Share upright and base details, arm loading patterns, stored product lengths, handling clearances and the rack inspection plan.

scenes.measureen: Local inclination of the selected cantilever-rack upright relative to its commissioning reference.

scenes.title: Drive-in pallet racking
scenes.en: Follow inclination at selected uprights in drive-in or drive-through pallet racking. Associate each sensor with a storage lane and rack member so observations can be reviewed against loading sequences, forklift activity and planned inspections. Compare readings with the commissioning reference and documented loading conditions to help warehouse teams locate a persistent change in the particular rack structure being monitored.

scenes.measureen: Local inclination of the selected drive-in rack upright under documented loading conditions.

scenes.title: Mobile pallet racking
scenes.en: Compare inclination at selected uprights on mobile pallet-rack systems when the racks are parked in a defined reference position. Record the rack location and loading state so later readings represent comparable conditions. The resulting angle history helps warehouse maintenance teams review persistent upright changes after relocation, wheel or rail servicing, loading changes and scheduled rack inspections.
scenes.pointen: An approved rigid upright location, with comparisons made at the agreed parked position.
scenes.briefen: Confirm mobile-base design, parked reference position, rack loads, travel clearances, movement schedule and maintenance access.

scenes.measureen: Static inclination of the selected upright at the agreed parked position and loading state.
